reserve_reason: Basket quick pins, frame joint angle brackets/corner hardware, remaining locking nuts, spring ends and anti-drop fasteners not yet fully detailed. Existing modelled wheel/mast M6s not counted twice.

support_screen.not_certification: Rigid level four-point support only; swivel sweep, payload shift, slope and one-wheel obstacles separately require tests.

analytical_structure.limit: Beam nominal screening only. Joint groups, gusset/base plate, three-wheel events and caster/fork bolts not FEA or certified. Deck requires 600x400 tote/supporting box base; concentrated feet need local spreading plate.
